## Coaching Note

After Black plays Kg6, look for **discovered attacks** when your pieces are lined up behind your own pieces. Here, moving the knight from d7 to e5 gives check *and* uncovers your rook's attack on Black's undefended rook on d8. This is a classic pattern: fork the king and rook. Black cannot move the rook to safety, so after any king move, you win the exchange with Rxd8. Always scan for these pin-like tactics where your own pieces hide threats.
